description.content:
Finage is a real-time and historical market data provider covering US and global stocks, forex, cryptocurrencies, indices, ETFs, bonds, and company fundamentals. This OpenAPI was generated by API Evangelist from Finage's own machine-readable docs database (https://api.finage.co.uk/op/v1/endpoints/list — the same JSON the docs at https://finage.co.uk/docs/api render); every path, parameter, and example comes from that source. All endpoints are read-only GET requests authenticated with an apikey query parameter. Responses must be requested with gzip Accept-Encoding (the API returns 406 "GZip compression required" otherwise).
